utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I can grab it from your place and drop it off at the community shop. Just let me know when to swing by.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks — I’ll let folks know you’re picking it up and dropping it at the community shop. If anything else comes up, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just send me the pickup time and I’ll take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It’s been moved to Sunday at the community center, so that’s where donations will be going. If you want, I can share the details so we can spread the word on the block.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rosa—that helps a lot. I can help spread the word and work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Faye—that would be wonderful. I’ll send you the updated details for Sunday at the community center so you can share them on the block.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right—sorting the donated tools and making a quick list of what’s missing still need doing. Just point me where to start.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing—let’s start with the donated tools, and I can help make that missing list too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks, Sam. Point me to the boxes and I’ll start sorting right away.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I’m on the tool table, and I’ll keep things moving there. If anything changes, let me know and I’ll coordinate.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Jules — I’m a little behind on the latest changes, so please keep me posted if anything shifts. I can help once I know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Will do — I’ll keep you posted if anything changes, and you can jump in once I know what’s needed at the tool table.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks, Ira — the donated items are by the community room table, and you can start there. If you find anything that needs checking, just set it aside for me.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it — I’ll take a look and set anything questionable aside for you. I’ll let you know what I find when I’m back.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate it. I’ll be by the community room if you need me.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, great—please spread the word to Leo too if you can! Anyone who wants to donate or help is welcome to stop by whenever they’re able.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do—I'll pass it along. The cracked edge by the curb and the loose patch near the garage are the main spots.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Leo — that’s really helpful. I’ll make sure folks know those are the main spots, and anyone who can donate or help is welcome to stop by whenever they’re able.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey, sorry I’m late — what part of the repair drive do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m not sure yet — I haven’t gone through the full list. If you can help sort what’s still needed, that would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — I can help sort through the list and see what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s great — the repair drive’s really picking up steam, and I can ask around if you need any tools or spare parts. Just let me know what would help most.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Tess — I’m still waiting on the details, but I’ll pass them along as soon as I get them. Just keep me posted and I’ll relay anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll keep an ear out and let folks know the repair drive’s still gathering tools and supplies. Just send me the details when you get them, and I’ll pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ve got Tuesday after 3 or Thursday morning penciled in. I’m checking on a car or van now, and I’ll let you know as soon as I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That works for me, Mina—just let me know which slot and vehicle you lock in. I can bring tools and any spare parts people need for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Perfect, Gus — I’ll confirm the vehicle and the time as soon as I’ve got it. Thanks for bringing tools and spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good morning, Hana. Have they confirmed whether they still need tape and a couple screwdrivers?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I haven’t confirmed yet, so I’d like to check before saying for sure. If you want, I can verify whether tape and a couple screwdrivers are still needed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, please check and let me know. I’d like a clear yes or no on the tape and screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be really helpful, Mina. If you have anything extra to spare, just bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure thing—I’ll keep an eye out for what’s still needed and bring by anything I can spare.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Cleo. I really appreciate you keeping an eye out and bringing whatever you can spare.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t seen the repair drive set up yet—do you know where they’re taking donations?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not sure yet — could you confirm whether the repair drive is still happening today? I’d rather wait to head over until I know.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t confirmed it yet, but I’m checking on where they’re taking donations. I’ll let you know as soon as I find out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It’s going alright, just a little slower than I expected. If you know anyone who can lend a hand with tools or pickup, that’d really help.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word for tools or a pickup and tell folks the repair drive needs a hand. We’re starting with the tool table, so I’ll keep that part moving too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Vik — that really helps. Let me know if you need me to sort donations or answer folks at the tool table.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what’s the drop-off plan?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I can help sort the donated parts and check what still needs fixing. Want me to start with the tool table?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, start with the tool table—that sounds good to me.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yes, I think so—sorry, I’m a little scattered. If anything changed, let me know and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — just making sure, it’s still on for today then?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, that still works for me. If you can confirm the car or van, I can plan around Tuesday after 3 or Thursday morning.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great—either Tuesday after 3 or Thursday morning works. I’ll confirm the car or van and let you know where to pick up the repair drive from my place.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Perfect, thanks — just let me know once the car or van is confirmed and where to pick it up from.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, that’s great to hear — I’m out running errands now, but I’ll keep an ear out and check what’s still needed when I get back.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Ira—just let me know when you’re back and what’s still needed for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll check in when I’m back and pass along anything I hear about what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll swing by with whatever I can find. Just let me know what’s still needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo—that’s so helpful. We’re now set for Sunday at the community center, and I still need hand tools, tape, and a few extra extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can bring hand tools and tape for sure, and I’ll see if I can dig up some extension cords too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Quinn, could you remind me which repairs we’re prioritizing for the drive? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: We’re mainly focusing on the most urgent household fixes—things like leaky plumbing, broken doors, and small electrical repairs. If you want, I can share the full list and spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Quinn—that helps. Yes, please share the full list, and I can help spread the word once I’ve double-checked the details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure, I can spread the word—I’ll tell people we’re collecting repair supplies all week. If you send me the short message, I’ll pass it along around the block.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Nell — please tell folks I can lend out tools and spare parts for the repair drive, so send anyone who needs them my way.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, Gus—I’ll tell people you’ve got tools and spare parts to lend. Send anyone who needs them your way, and I’ll pass it along around the block.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can bring gloves and packing tape, and I’ll help with the drop-off list. Just let me know the timing once you’ve double-checked it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Jules. I’ll double-check the timing and let you know once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks Eli—just send me the time and I’ll be there with the gloves, tape, and drop-off list.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I can ask around and see if they still need tape and a couple of screwdrivers. I’ll pass along whatever I hear about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Tess. If you hear back, just let me know—I'm mainly still after the filler for the cracked edge and loose patch.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing—I’ll ask around about the filler for the cracked edge and loose patch, and let you know what I hear.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 10 sounds workable for me. If you want, I can help line it up around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Faye—10 works for me too. Just point me to whatever still needs doing, and I’ll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I’ll check what still needs doing and line it up around school drop-off times. I’ll let you know as soon as I have the details.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Mina — we still need a few tools, some volunteer hands, and help sorting the donated items. If you can, just tell me where you’d like to start.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can help sort the donated items. What’s the best place for me to start?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — the donated items are by the community hall entrance. Thanks, Mina, and let me know if you need help finding anything.
